The exact factorial-energy ratio is |c|^−2 ∏_{r=1}^m(N+r)/∏_{r=m+1}^{m+n}(N+r), asymptotic N^(m−n)/|c|², giving all strict regimes: n Fock modes for m<n or m=n,|c|>1; none for m>n or m=n,|c|<1. Strict Fock regimes have all weighted polynomial moments, hence symbol-integrable W dimension n; critical W=0. Independent exact rational factorial checks for p=1,2,3,5 and N=0,1,13,49 gave strictly positive angular bracket, corroborating algebra; infinite asymptotics, not tests, prove classification.
